create_session_timeout_policy: create a Django model instance of SessionTimeoutPolicy with organization and timeout settings
configure_max_session_age: configure the max_session_age field to set the maximum session duration in minutes before re-login is required
configure_max_time_between_activity: configure the max_time_between_activity field to set the idle timeout in minutes before a session expires
query_session_timeout_policy: query the SessionTimeoutPolicy model for a given organization's timeout configuration
update_session_timeout_policy: update an existing SessionTimeoutPolicy instance with new timeout values for an organization
